title: SWSS Pool • Golf Simulator • Sport Court • Sauna
description:
SWSS Elite Retreat offers...
✓ Heart of Scottsdale; 10 minutes to Old Town, close to golf, hiking, restaurants
✓ Sleeps 32 (7 kings, 6 queens, 5 twins)
✓ Fully stocked kitchen
✓ Concierge services offering many approved vendors (chefs, massage, yoga, casino and lots more!)
✓ Additional verification required for last minute bookings within 7 days of arrival and local residents
✓ Unapproved vendors not permissible at this property
review_snippets: This home is a guest favorite based on ratings, reviews, and reliability

Had a wonderful time at the Elite Retreat! We loved the pool and played a lot of cornhole! The kitchen had everything we needed and we used every bit of the game room! Perfect location for our family reunion!

Had a wonderful stay at this spacious home! The house was large, clean, and perfect for a group gathering. Everything was well organized, and the host made the experience easy from start to finish. Highly recommend for anyone traveling with family or friends!
Amazing home. So grateful to Darlene and the team for making this once in a lifetime opportunity happen for our boys trip.
What a fantastic place. We didn’t want to leave!

This oasis was ideal for our large group. Bedrooms are huge, ideal common areas and the outside area is simply exceptional.  Darlene, the property manager, was friendly and uber responsive. We highly recommend this property!
